title: Mental health counselors licensing program
bodyText: . There is established a mental health counselors licensing program within the department to be administered by the director.
bodyHtml: [§453D-2]  Mental health counselors licensing program.  There is established a mental health counselors licensing program within the department to be administered by the director. [L 2004, c 209, pt of §2; am L 2008, c 206, §1]
